main.description: A public need or offer of support for a project, published by its representative.

projectUri.description: DID-based AT URI of the associated org.hypercerts.collection record with type project.

kind.description: Whether the project seeks or offers support.

title.description: Short label for the support sought or offered.

description.description: Public details supplied by the publisher.

capitalForms.description: Distinct forms of capital that apply. Order has no meaning.

status.description: Open listings remain active until closed or withdrawn, or until their optional expiry.

createdAt.description: When this public listing was first created.

expiresAt.description: Optional end time. Without one, an open listing remains active until closed or withdrawn.

updatedAt.description: The reviewed publication version time. It changes on explicit republication, protecting a newer listing from delayed withdrawal of an earlier version.
